missing_links_and_anything_unverified_35: Missing links and anything unverified are listed under the draft, never inside it
select_any_text_in_the_493624: Select any text in the chat to copy or translate it; in the message box, replace it with the translation
the_first_translation_tells_you_58712b: The first translation tells you which AI the text goes to
missing_the_cutover_checklist_link_7152c: Missing: the cutover checklist link wasn't found, so it isn't in the message.
undertone_tells_work_meetings_from_18a79: Undertone tells work meetings from personal ones. A webinar or a call on your personal calendar is explained from general knowledge, without touching your work tools.
mark_each_calendar_work_or_a5860d: Mark each calendar Work or Personal; company accounts start as Work
personal_meetings_skip_your_work_a2b2ea: Personal meetings skip your work tools and memory, and their recaps stay out of amem
switch_any_meeting_between_work_e91c22: Switch any meeting between Work and Personal from the hints panel
starts_on_its_own_for_93e78f: Starts on its own for webinars you only listen to, and in more browsers like Comet, Vivaldi and Opera
says_who_a_question_was_4ad923: Says who a question was for: you, someone else by name, or the whole room
a_call_that_drops_and_866862: A call that drops and comes back continues the same meeting instead of starting a new one
personal_meeting_on_a_personal_5967c6: Personal meeting · on a personal calendar
undertone_comes_in_17_languages_ed9f15: Undertone comes in 17 languages. It follows your Mac's language, and you can pick another in Settings.
hints_answers_and_recaps_are_8d27ae: Hints, answers and recaps are written in your language; terms from the meeting stay as they were said
meetings_held_in_any_of_dc019b: Meetings held in any of 19 languages and dialects are transcribed on your Mac
choose_which_calendars_to_use_5c9619: Choose which calendars to use, across all your Google, iCloud and Outlook accounts
up_next_reads_google_calendar_7e0e0d: Up next reads Google Calendar directly when it's connected, so renamed or cancelled meetings don't linger
your_meetings_in_your_ai_2b7bb9: Your meetings, in your AI tools
undertone_is_also_an_mcp_d702b4: Undertone is also an MCP server, so any AI app that supports MCP can work with your meetings, tasks and glossary. Settings adds it to Claude, Claude Code or Cursor in one click; for other apps, copy the settings below. Read-only, and it stays on your Mac.
undertone_always_keeps_its_own_94e199: Undertone always keeps its own memory of your meetings. Add amem, the memory on your Mac that Claude Code, Cursor and your other AI tools share, and Undertone searches both together. Setup offers it and installs it for you.
what_you_worked_on_with_a726a0: What you worked on with Claude Code or Cursor is context in your next call
every_meeting_recap_is_there_4d391c: Every meeting recap is there in your AI tools afterwards
what_you_tell_undertone_is_fb7cfe: What you tell Undertone is remembered for good
or_let_undertone_s_setup_497eb4: Or let Undertone's setup install it. Needs Node.js. Stays on your Mac.
your_calls_keys_and_meetings_6ba803: Your calls, keys and meetings stay with you. With your own AI, the only thing Undertone itself receives is an anonymous count you can switch off.
the_call_and_your_mic_34f257: The call and your mic are transcribed on your Mac with Apple's SpeechAnalyzer. Never uploaded.
recaps_transcripts_tasks_the_glossary_30: Recaps, transcripts, tasks, the glossary and your artifacts are stored only on your Mac.
read_to_show_what_s_3a3396: Read to show what's next. Undertone never creates or changes events.
your_own_openai_gemini_or_7f04e7: Your own OpenAI, Gemini or Anthropic key, a local Ollama or LM Studio model, or your Cursor or Claude Code sign-in. Keys stay in your Keychain.
if_you_start_with_free_bd13c0: If you start with free credits, requests go through Undertone's server to Google Gemini. It keeps your email, your balance and usage totals, never what was said.
read_only_undertone_only_searches_df974e: Read-only. Undertone only searches and reads; tools that send, post, create or edit are never allowed.
if_you_leave_count_me_12e86d: If you leave “Count me as a user” on: one anonymous ping when Undertone is first opened and at most one a week, with a random ID, the app version, macOS version and language. Switching it off in setup or Settings deletes what was sent.
don_t_take_our_word_bef89d: Don't take our word for it
undertone_is_closed_source_what_36ee17: Undertone is closed source. What's public on GitHub is this site, our security notes, and the format of every file Undertone keeps on your Mac, so you can see exactly what it stores.
to_check_what_leaves_your_51b290: To check what leaves your Mac, watch Undertone's traffic with Little Snitch, LuLu or Proxyman during a call. You'll only see connections to the AI you chose, the tools you connected and, if you left it on, the weekly anonymous count. Your audio never leaves your Mac; only text goes to your AI.
every_feature_on_this_page_4186b5: Every feature on this page is free during the beta. Start with free credits on us, or bring the AI you already use, and help shape what Undertone becomes.
